title: User Guide
subtitle: A practical handbook for members, attendance and staff administration.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.summary: Sign in with your staff account and find your daily tools.
steps: Open the application and enter the email address and password supplied by your administrator. Select Sign in.
Use the menu on the left to open a page. On a phone, open the menu using the menu icon at the top.
Start on Dashboard to review today's activity. The top bar on desktop displays the current date and time.
Use the sign-out icon beside your staff profile when you finish, especially on a shared device.
sections.note: An internet connection is required. Available pages and actions depend on your account's access. If access is denied, ask an administrator to review your role.

sections.title: Register a member
sections.summary: Create a member record before recording their first visit.
steps: Open Register Member from the menu and complete the fields marked as required, including the member's personal and contact information.
Check names and contact details carefully. If a possible duplicate is shown, review the existing record before creating another member.
Submit the form and wait for the confirmation. The application assigns a member ID using the ACG- prefix.
Keep the member's ID and QR card available for future visits. Use the paper registration form when you need to collect details on paper, then enter them in the application.
sections.note: A member record is not a staff sign-in account. Staff accounts are managed separately under User Management.

sections.title: Members and QR cards
sections.summary: Find a member, review their profile and provide their card.
steps: Open Members and use the search field to locate an existing member.
Select a member to review their profile and visit information. Use the available edit controls to correct details when your role allows it.
Open the membership card controls to view the QR card. Use the available download, print or sharing options as needed.
Ask the member to present their QR code or member ID at reception on each visit.
sections.note: A general membership QR code identifies the member for center visits. A program participant card has a separate code for program attendance. Use the correct card.

sections.title: Center check-in and check-out
sections.summary: Record arrival and departure at the center independently of room visits.
steps: Open QR Scanner. Select Open camera and allow camera access, or type the member ID and select Search.
Confirm that the displayed name and ID belong to the member in front of you.
On arrival, select Check-in Center. Wait for the confirmation and the In Center status.
On departure, scan or search for the same member and select Check-out Center. Review Recent activity to confirm the event.
sections.note: Center presence and room presence are recorded separately. Checking out of a room does not record departure from the center; record both when appropriate.

sections.title: Computer Lab and other spaces
sections.summary: Track use of the Computer Lab, Discussion Room and Reading Lounge.
steps: Find the member on QR Scanner and review the space status badges.
For the Discussion Room or Reading Lounge, choose the intended stay duration before checking the member in.
Select the check-in button for the correct space. If the Computer Lab is full, wait for a place to become available.
When the member leaves a space, scan or search again and select its check-out button. Check Dashboard for current occupancy and remaining time.
sections.note: The Computer Lab uses a fixed stay duration. The application records expected check-out times; always record actual departures rather than relying only on automatic check-out.

sections.title: Dashboard and Statistics
sections.summary: Review today's activity and explore attendance trends.
steps: Use Dashboard for today's check-ins, check-outs, currently inside counts and occupancy by space.
Select a count to open the corresponding member list and inspect the records behind the number.
Open Statistics and use the available date and view controls to review the period you need.
Review chart legends and details. Select interactive counts or chart entries to inspect the associated members or visit history.
sections.note: Check-in and check-out totals count events, while unique-member counts count people. One member may generate several events. Center occupancy and room occupancy describe different records.

sections.title: Programs, participants and sessions
sections.summary: Prepare a program and its participants before taking attendance.
steps: Open Programs and select an existing program, or create one using New program when that action is available.
Enter the program name and its details, then save. Open the program to manage its participants and sessions.
Search existing members when adding participants. Review possible matches before creating a new participant, and assign the appropriate participant role.
Create the session for the scheduled date. Provide participants with their program-specific QR card or participant code.
sections.note: Program editing and deletion are available only where authorized. Confirm the program and session details before recording attendance.

sections.title: Program attendance and reports
sections.summary: Mark attendance for the right program and session, then review results.
steps: Open Program Attendance and choose the program, session and space. Verify the selected session date.
Scan the participant's program QR code or enter their participant code to mark them present. Use the available participant-list actions for manual attendance where needed.
Review the Present, Waiting and Absent lists. Search by participant name or code to check an individual record.
Open Program Report, select the program and review attendance by session and participant. Use the available filters to inspect the results.
sections.note: If a participant is not found, check their enrollment and use their program-specific code. If they are already present or marked absent, review the record instead of repeatedly scanning.

sections.title: Staff accounts and access control
sections.summary: Administrator tools for staff profiles and module permissions.
steps: Open User Management to create a staff account. Complete the required identity, contact, employment and emergency-contact fields, and choose the staff role.
If uploading a staff photo, use an image no larger than 2 MB. Save the account and verify that it appears in the staff list.
Use the staff row actions to edit a profile or reset a password when needed. Share sign-in details privately with the staff member.

Open Access Control. Under By Role, select a role and set the module checkboxes for View, Create, Update and Delete. Use By User (override) for individual exceptions, and clear an override to return to the role settings.
sections.note: Read-only access uses View without Create, Update or Delete. Full CRUD includes all four actions. Administrator and American Center are system full-access roles. Never share passwords in reports or public messages.

sections.title: Daily checks and troubleshooting
sections.summary: Resolve common problems and keep attendance records reliable.
steps: If the camera does not open, allow camera access in your browser settings and close other apps using it. You can enter the ID manually instead.
If a member is not found, check the spelling of the ID and confirm registration. For program attendance, verify the program and participant code.
If saving fails, check your internet connection and access rights. Review the list or recent activity before retrying, to avoid duplicate records.
At the end of the day, review center and room occupancy, record missed departures, and check program attendance. Sign out from shared devices.
sections.note: Keep member information private. Downloaded files and shared card links should only be given to the intended recipient. Ask an administrator for account or access issues.
